name: save_specimen
title: Save to shelf
description: Saves a prompt to the user's Meerkat shelf at getmeerkat.dev. Takes the prompt text, and optionally a title, a project id to file it under, and notes. Returns the saved prompt's id, its title (derived from the prompt when none is given), its project id and a link to it on the shelf. Fails if the project id is not one of the user's projects.

prompt.description: The full prompt text to save, verbatim.

title.description: Optional. A short title for the shelf entry (3 to 8 words). When omitted, one is derived from the prompt.

project_id.description: Optional. The id of one of the user's projects to file the prompt under.

notes.description: Optional. Free-form notes stored with the prompt.
